BILL NUMBER:  S627

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the executive law, in relation to the compilation of
firearm and ballistic data

 PURPOSE :
This bill will require that any expended projectile, expended shell
casing or gun seized, found or otherwise coming into possession of any
state or local law enforcement agency be submitted to the division of
state police, to be entered in the automated electronic databank.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1 of this bill amends subdivision 4 of section 230 of the
executive law by adding paragraphs (b) and (c). Paragraph (b) sets
forth the submission requirements being placed on state and local law
enforcement agencies of the division of the state police. Paragraph
(c) requires that materials submitted must be done so within thirty
days of coming into the possession of a state or local law enforcement
agency.

Section 2 is the effective date for this bill.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Currently, local law enforcement agencies are not required to submit
evidence to a centralized crime laboratory. Requiring agencies to do
so would facilitate the exchange of information, increasing the
effectiveness of both the labs and the local law enforcement agencies.
Requiring submission of certain materials to a crime laboratory and
entry into a computerized ballistic system will allow these materials
to be cross-checked with previously entered materials.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2006 Referred to Finance
2007 Referred to Finance
2008 Referred to Finance

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the 120th day after it shall have become
law.

summary: Provides for the submission by state and local law enforcement authorities of expended projectiles and shell casings and guns, found or otherwise coming into their possession, to the state police pistol and revolver ballistic identification electronic databank; requires the law enforcement agencies to make a record thereof and submit within 30 days.
